topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I found this list, tucked away in a drawer where I was sure no one would ever see it. But here I am, eyes scanning over the lines, each one making my throat a bit tighter. It’s a bucket list, all these things they want to do, places to go, adventures to have. I wonder, does any of it involve me? We talk all the time, I thought I knew, but this—it’s like a secret part of them I stumbled upon. What if these dreams are bigger than the life we’re building together? I can’t stop thinking about it, wondering if I measure up to these big plans. I guess I’ll have to bring it up, but the thought of that conversation...it’s enough to make you want to hide under the covers and pretend you never found anything.
